# ViraStack Mask (full)

> `@virastack/mask` (2.x): zero-config input masks for React Hook Form. Headless, no CSS, zero runtime dependencies. The form stores raw values; inputs show masked text. v1 docs: https://virastack.com/mask/v1/llms-full.txt

## Install

```bash
npm install @virastack/mask
# peers: react >= 18.2, react-hook-form >= 7.55
```

Docs: https://virastack.com/mask/docs · Index: https://virastack.com/mask/llms.txt · Repo: https://github.com/virastack/mask

## Critical rules for agents

1. Call `useViraMask(form, schema)`: the first argument is what `useForm()` returns. (v1's `useViraMask({ form, schema })` no longer exists.)
2. Schema keys are form field paths. `phone`, `iban`, `currency` and `number` take `country: "TR"` for the Turkish layout; defaults are global. For nested fields quote the key (`"address.zip"`) or set `name`.
3. Spread the returned object onto the input as is. There is no `rawValue`; read raw values with `form.watch(name)` / `getValues`.
4. Don't pass `value`: the input is uncontrolled (`defaultValue`). `reset()` and `setValue()` update it; pass raw values (ISO for dates).
5. With a resolver (Zod, Valibot), wrap it: `resolver: maskResolver(masks, zodResolver(schema))` or `maskResolver(masks, schema)`. Otherwise mask validation is skipped.
6. In Server Components, Server Actions and shared schema files import from `@virastack/mask/server` (the root entry is `"use client"`).
7. Errors are keys (`tckn.invalid`, `phone.incomplete`), not messages. Map them in your i18n layer.

## Quick start

```tsx
import { useForm } from "react-hook-form"
import { useViraMask } from "@virastack/mask"

function Checkout() {
  const form = useForm<{ phone: string; card: string; cvv: string }>()
  const { phone, card, cvv } = useViraMask(form, {
    phone: { preset: "phone", country: "TR" },
    card: "card",
    cvv: { preset: "cvv", from: "card" },
  })
  return (
    <form onSubmit={form.handleSubmit(console.log)}>
      <input {...phone} />
      <input {...card} />
      <input {...cvv} />
    </form>
  )
}
// form.watch("phone") → "5551234567"
```

## Presets

| Preset | Display | Form value | Error keys |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `phone` | `+90 (555) 123 45 67`, others `+4915112345678` | `+905551234567` (E.164) | `phone.incomplete` |
| `phone` + `country: "TR"` | `(555) 123 45 67` (type +90, 0090, 0 or 555) | `5551234567` | `phone.incomplete` |
| `iban` | `GB82 WEST 1234 5698 7654 32` (any country) | `GB82WEST12345698765432` | `iban.incomplete`, `iban.invalid` |
| `iban` + `country: "TR"` | `TR33 0006 1005 1978 6457 8413 26` | `TR330006100519786457841326` | `iban.incomplete`, `iban.invalid` |
| `card` | `4111 1111 1111 1111`, Amex `3782 822463 10005` | digits | `card.incomplete`, `card.invalid` (Luhn) |
| `cvv` | 3 digits, 4 when `from` card is Amex | digits | `cvv.incomplete` |
| `expiry` | `12/28`, past months invalid | `1228` | `expiry.incomplete`, `expiry.invalid`, `expiry.min` |
| `tckn` | `10000000146` | digits | `tckn.incomplete`, `tckn.invalid` |
| `vkn` | `1234567890` | digits | `vkn.incomplete`, `vkn.invalid` |
| `currency` | `1,234.56` (no symbol); with a code `$1,234.56` (Intl) | `1234.56` | `currency.min`, `currency.max` |
| `currency` + `country: "TR"` | `₺1.234,56` | `1234.56` | `currency.min`, `currency.max` |
| `number` | `1,234` | `1234` | `number.min`, `number.max` |
| `number` + `country: "TR"` | `1.234` | `1234` | `number.min`, `number.max` |
| `date` | `29/07/2026` | `2026-07-29` (ISO) | `date.incomplete`, `date.invalid`, `date.min`, `date.max`, `date.minAge`, `date.beforeFrom` |

## Schema entry

```ts
useViraMask(form, {
  tckn: "tckn",                                                   // preset name
  birthDate: { preset: "date", date: { max: "today", minAge: 18 } }, // preset + overrides
  phone: { preset: "phone", country: "TR", rules: { required: "required" } }, // national layout + register rules
  price: { preset: "currency", from: "currency" },                   // linked field
  endDate: { preset: "date", from: "startDate" },                    // can't be before start
  "address.zip": { mask: "99999" },                                  // nested field
  iban: { preset: "iban", country: "TR", output: "masked" },         // write masked text to the form
  card: { preset: "card", onComplete: () => form.setFocus("expiry") },
})
```

Returned props per key: `name`, `ref`, `defaultValue`, `onChange`, `onBlur`, `onCompositionEnd`, `type`, `inputMode`, `autoComplete`, `disabled?`, `aria-invalid?`.

## Custom masks

- Pattern: `9` digit, `a` letter, `*` letter or digit, `\` escape, `[...]` optional part, `{...}` fixed part kept in the value.
- `tokens: { h: /[0-9a-f]/i }`, `transform: "uppercase" | "lowercase"`, `normalize: (value) => string`.
- Dynamic: `mask: ["999-999", "9999-9999"]` or `mask: (value, ctx) => pattern` (`ctx.from` is the linked field).
- `number: { min, max, scale, signed, locale }`, `currency: "USD" | { code, locale, min, max, scale }`, `date: { format, min, max, minAge }` (formats `DD/MM/YYYY`, `MM/DD/YYYY`, `YYYY-MM-DD`, `DD.MM.YYYY`, `MM/YY`, `MM/YYYY`).
- `mask`, `number`, `currency` and `date` exclude each other (type error).
- `validate: (value, ctx) => true | false | "my.key"` runs after built-in checks.
- `definePreset("plate", { mask: "99 a[aa] 99[99]", transform: "uppercase" })` → error keys `plate.*`.

## Server

```ts
"use server"
import { parseMasked } from "@virastack/mask/server"

export async function checkout(formData: FormData) {
  const result = await parseMasked(checkoutMasks, formData, zodSchema) // schema optional (any Standard Schema)
  if (!result.success) return { errors: result.errors } // { phone: "phone.incomplete" }
  // result.data → raw values, nested names expanded
}
```

## Helpers

`createMask(spec)` → `{ format, parse, validate, isComplete }` · `getCardType` · `isValidCard`, `isValidLuhn`, `isValidTCKN`, `isValidVKN`, `isValidIBAN` (any country; country code sets the length) · `toMinorUnits("1234.56", "TRY") → 123456` · `maskResolver(masks, resolverOrStandardSchema)`.

## Upgrade from v1

`useViraMask({ form, schema })` → `useViraMask(form, schema)`; `rawValue` removed; `phone` → `{ preset: "phone", country: "TR" }` for the Turkish layout or E.164 `"phone"`; `iban` → `{ preset: "iban", country: "TR" }` (value keeps `TR`) or global `"iban"`; `taxNumber` → `vkn`; `numeric` → `number`; `email`, `url`, `username`, `alpha`, `password`, `text`, `zipCode` removed; `resolveMask` → `mask` function; `errorMessage` → error keys; `mergeRefs`, `applyMask`, `formatCurrency` removed (use `createMask`). Full guide: https://virastack.com/mask/docs/upgrade
